## Summary

Describe the user problem and the focused change that solves it.

## Verification

- [ ] I ran the checks relevant to this change.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for behavior with meaningful regression risk.
- [ ] I checked migrations, synchronization, encryption, and data portability where relevant.
- [ ] I considered web, macOS, Windows, Android, mobile portrait, and tablet behavior where relevant.
- [ ] I updated every affected locale.
- [ ] I did not include credentials, private user content, backups, or recovery material.

List commands run and any checks that could not be completed:

```text

```

## Product evidence

For interface changes, add focused screenshots or recordings for the affected desktop and mobile layouts. Use synthetic content only.

## Compatibility and risk

Describe data migrations, protocol changes, rollback considerations, and any user-visible edge cases. Write `None` when this section does not apply.

## Contribution certificate

All commits must be signed off under the [Developer Certificate of Origin](https://github.com/locoris/locoris/blob/main/DCO) with `git commit --signoff`.
